_archetype.origin: Light & Wonder (formerly Bally / Scientific Games) — 'Blazing 777 Triple Double Jackpot Wild — Nudging Stacks' family
_archetype.chassis_reference: Classic 3-reel 9-line stepper + bidirectional stacked-wild nudge mechanic
_archetype.chassis_reference_rtp_benchmark: ~92-95% for stepper class with nudge feature
_archetype.mechanic_reference: Triple-stacked wild trio (wild_up + wild2x_mid + wild_down) lands together at adjacent strip positions; partial visibility triggers free MoveSpins (max 2 per archetype 'nudge up to two times') that nudge the stack toward full reveal
_archetype.asymmetric_design: Asymmetric reel weight pattern (reel 1 = 'lead' with denser paying symbols; reels 2/3 = 'kill' reels with heavy blanks) — common stepper convention to drag down line hit rate while maintaining anticipation
pay_modifications_vs_archetype: Added Asian-market collect-to-wheel mechanic: meter fills 1 per paid spin, at 1000 triggers 12-cell fixed-value Wheel feature (5/10/20/30/50/100× bet payouts) — Blazing 777 archetype is base+nudge only, no wheel
5 jackpot tiers (pay_id 101 = 250×, 102 = 150×, 103 = 50×, 104 = 15×) — archetype has 5 fixed JP levels but exact ratios are LHS-tuned
Top jackpot 250× via pure 3 wild3x — archetype has 750× via Triple Jackpot symbol; LHS reduced to 250× because wheel feature already contributes ~10pp RTP separately
BuffCollectionMap (ST=102) is UI overlay only — archetype has no equivalent (LHS-added trigger marker)
_archetype.confidence: high (paytable + spin_type breakdown reverse-engineered from rawdata + machineconfig/M279Cfg.txt; archetype mechanic + cell layout matches Light & Wonder patent-class behavior)
_archetype.modifications_explanation: M279 = Blazing 777 archetype + Asian-market collect-to-wheel feature add-on. The collect+wheel mechanic borrows from Konami / Aristocrat collect-style features (e.g., Buffalo Stampede meter), not from Light & Wonder's original Blazing 777 lineage.

_invariants: Wild stack anchor: wild_up / wild2x_mid / wild_down ALWAYS appear at adjacent strip positions in this exact order (top→bot). Strip layout MUST place these as consecutive triples; Phase 5 SA tuner must respect this constraint (treat the trio as an atomic 'super-stop' that swaps as a unit).
All 3 reels (col 0, 1, 2) carry the same wild stack layout — the stack lands at the same strip positions across reels (symmetric stepper).

1 wild stack anchor per reel (positions 28-30) — single anchor at center of strip. 2-anchor variant from v0 caused too-frequent nudge triggers (20%+ vs 12% target); single anchor + sparser blank cluster sized strip yields proper distribution.

Strip uses 3-blank-cluster pattern between paying symbols (rather than strict blank/non-blank alternation), giving per-cell non-blank marginal ~22% vs 50% with alternation. Critical for hit rate target.
No reroll_blocks (M37-specific mechanic; M279 doesn't block any wild combo from paying).
Max payout: pay_id 101 (3 wild3x) = 250× bet (250000 credits). Wheel max = 100× bet (100000 credits). Either alone is the player-facing 'top jackpot' moment.
_near_miss_design: 1 stack anchor per reel + 60-stop strip → ~12% chance per spin of landing partial stack (= MoveSpin trigger). Matches archetype Blazing Sevens 'nudge up to two times' frequency.

Wild stack center (wild2x_mid at row 1) is the 2× multiplier zone — full-stack reveal puts wild2x_mid on every payline that crosses row 1 (= line 1 / 8 / 9 + center cells of V/^ lines = 5 of 9 lines).
Single wild2x and wild3x positions provide independent multiplier moments outside the stack — payline lands wild2x or wild3x at center → 2× / 3× multiplier on the winning line.
_notes: 2026-04-28 v2: redesigned with 3-blank cluster pattern + single stack anchor for proper hit rate.
Phase 4 tuner adjusts per-reel asymmetric weights (reel 1 lead vs reel 2/3 kill).
Phase 5 joint SA: stack trio is atomic super-stop — DO NOT split during shuffle.
